stem: Which table correctly identifies the function of each type of RNA?

options.label: A
options.text:
Type of RNA               Function
Transfer RNA         Carries genetic information from DNA to ribosomes
Ribosomal RNA       A component of ribosomes that helps catalyze protein synthesis
Messenger RNA    Brings amino acids to growing polypeptides in ribosomes
